sections.name: architecture
sections.value: One query path, one bounded search page. The old candidate_vectors CTE admitted each HNSW candidate through correlated element and smart_content EXISTS probes, producing roughly one million smart-content lookups per search. The shipped query pre-resolves caller scope into raw-hash and smart-text-hash source keys, applies those cheap keys inside the HNSW scan so iterative_scan can pass nearer foreign vectors, and resolves smart payload plus deterministic element representatives once per candidate page above the LIMIT. candidate_vectors carries only source_hash, source_kind, chunk_no, and distance. Candidate and admitted counts are independent: unchanged admitted growth stops expansion; the filtered ceiling returns a short SearchPage with scan metadata rather than an outage. The daemon publishes additive scan_incomplete and passes metadata. Evidence is an EXPLAIN shape/mutation test with smart_content Actual Loops ≤ candidate_limit, paired 12,000-foreign/5-scoped geometry, no-growth and no-Err mutations, parity golden, focused suites, then production EXPLAIN and load-controlled timings.

value.rationale: One unit, one coder, no PM; o-prime coordinates directly (Jordan, 2026-09-02: dispatch the performance work to agents).

value.responsibility: admission as hash joins; no per-candidate probes; no vectors in the CTE; identical ranking
value.interface: search_elements returns SearchPage { hits, passes, candidate_limit_exhausted }; daemon SearchOutcome and envelope meta add scan_incomplete and passes while existing fields keep their shape; ranking and scoring unchanged; goldens committed
value.test_strategy: EXPLAIN-shape test with a one-line mutation to the old SQL; parity golden; existing suites; prod EXPLAIN + timings after bounce
value.note: ac-0001–0003 in the worktree; ac-0004/0005 on prod with o-prime after the bounce.

Worktree ../fs3-search-admission on branch 013-search-admission. Per-seat CARGO_TARGET_DIR. Per-run test DBs on :5433 with your own label — seed a corpus large enough that the plan shape is real (≥50k elements) or the EXPLAIN test proves nothing. NEVER :7373 for tests; read-only prod EXPLAIN/timings are REQUIRED after the bounce. One cargo at a time; ask o-prime for the gate slot.

value.steps: None — single unit. o-prime squash-merges and bounces prod (daemon/store binary changes).
value.integration_proof: the real-usage criteria in the plan, measured on prod after the bounce

value.when: spawned by o-prime once the PR is up
value.inputs: the three owed lists: (1) least confident — does the rewrite change WHICH candidates are admitted under each filter kind (path glob, source, conversation pin), does the semi-join dedupe candidates that the old OR-EXISTS admitted twice, is the plan shape stable when the seeded corpus is small vs prod-sized, does JIT still fire; (2) disbelieve — re-run the EXPLAIN-shape test and perform the mutation (old SQL) yourself; re-derive parity from the golden; run the prod EXPLAIN yourself read-only after the bounce; (3) known-open — rows 139/140/141/124b, zero findings.

value.text: Parity golden captured from a query that is itself wrong in some edge (e.g. double-admission) would freeze the bug — the coder must state any golden row it believes is wrong at ack rather than match it
A planner that still chooses a nested loop on a small seeded corpus — the shape test must seed enough rows, or assert on prod-sized stats via pg_stat
Filters that were applied inside the correlated EXISTS (kind, gate_open, ddoc_schema, conversation) must be applied to the admitted set with identical semantics — enumerate each in the ack
Candidate expansion: if parity requires the same under-fill behaviour, the loop stays; document the pass count for the reference query before/after
